The player sounds the instrument with a double reed, the air passing through a crook shaped like the neck of a tenor saxophone; the body is folded only once, so the metal tube should be held steadily so that the crook comes to the mouth. For a beginner the emphasis is on getting used to double-reed vibration and to playing an instrument pitched in E♭; the source does not cover fingering, embouchure or breathing.

After that the instruments were no longer made in regular production, and today they can be ordered only from Orsi or from the German instrument maker Benedikt Eppelsheim.
